questions.description: 编写生成器生成前 count 个斐波那契数字，并转为列表。 已给定数据和 base；最后一行按“base 计算结果”输出，请补全 result 的表达式。
questions.code_template:
base = 2500
def fibonacci(count):
    x, y = 0, 1
    for _ in range(count):
        yield x
        x, y = y, x + y
count = 7
result = ___
print(base, result)
questions.hints: 生成器用 yield 暂停并保存函数内部状态。
questions.solution:
base = 2500
def fibonacci(count):
    x, y = 0, 1
    for _ in range(count):
        yield x
        x, y = y, x + y
count = 7
result = list(fibonacci(count))
print(base, result)

questions.description: 用 yield 逐个归并两个升序序列，不重复使用 sorted。 已给定数据和 base；最后一行按“base 计算结果”输出，请补全 result 的表达式。
questions.code_template:
base = 2515
def merge_sorted(left, right):
    a = iter(left)
    b = iter(right)
    x, y = next(a, None), next(b, None)
    while x is not None or y is not None:
        if y is None or (x is not None and x <= y):
            yield x
            x = next(a, None)
        else:
            yield y
            y = next(b, None)
left = [5, 10, 17]
right = [6, 8]
result = ___
print(base, result)
questions.hints: 维持每个迭代器当前元素，仅推进本轮较小的一方。
questions.solution:
base = 2515
def merge_sorted(left, right):
    a = iter(left)
    b = iter(right)

        if y is None or (x is not None and x <= y):
            yield x

        else:
            yield y

right = [6, 8]
result = list(merge_sorted(left, right))

questions.description: 编写生成器，随着窗口滑动依次产生宽度为 3 的窗口和。 已给定数据和 base；最后一行按“base 计算结果”输出，请补全 result 的表达式。
questions.code_template:
base = 2530
from collections import deque
def window_sums(items, width):
    window = deque(maxlen=width)
    for value in items:
        window.append(value)
        if len(window) == width:
            yield sum(window)
values = [15, 10, 3, 7, 5]
result = ___
print(base, result)
questions.hints: deque(maxlen=width) 会自动丢弃最旧元素。

values = [15, 10, 3, 7, 5]
result = list(window_sums(values, 3))
print(base, result)
